decision.instructions: Classify the user's primary intent in a debt negotiation. Choose the single best match based on the whole message.

criteria.CONFIRM_NEGOTIATION: Accepts or confirms the proposed payment arrangement.
criteria.REQUEST_DISCOUNT: Says the proposed amount is too high or asks to reduce it.
criteria.REQUEST_DATE: Says the payment date is too soon or asks for more time to pay.
criteria.REQUEST_REPEAT: Did not understand the offer or asks to hear it again.
criteria.TALK_WITH_HUMAN: Asks to speak with a human agent or be transferred from the AI.
criteria.DENY_DEBT: Denies owing the debt or disputes the amount owed.
criteria.ALREADY_PAID: States that the debt or requested payment has already been paid.
criteria.OUT_OF_CONTEXT: Coherent message unrelated to the debt or payment negotiation.
criteria.UNINTELLIGIBLE: Unreadable or incoherent message with no discernible intent.
